string.ConfirmationText: Thank you for your interest in {name}. To complete the sign up process, please paste the following link into your browser's URL bar: {link}. Regards, {name} Team.
string.ConfirmationHTML:
Hello,

Thank you for your interest in {name}. To complete the sign up process, please click this link or paste the following link into your browser's URL bar.

{link}

Regards,

{name} Team.
string.ConfirmationSubject: Confirm your email address to sign up for {name}
string.RecoveryText: We received a request to reset the password for your account. To reset your password, please paste the following link into your browser's URL bar: {link}. If you have not requested a password reset, please ignore this email.
string.RecoveryHTML:
We received a request to reset the password for your account. To reset your password, please click the link below: Reset password

If the reset password link above does not work, paste the following link into your browser's URL bar: {link}

If you have not requested a password reset, please ignore this email.
string.InviteText: You were invited to {ws}. To join, please paste the following link into your browser's URL bar: {link}. The link is valid for {expHours} hours.
string.InviteHTML:
You were invited to {ws}. To join, please click the link below: Join

If the invite link above does not work, paste the following link into your browser's URL bar: {link}

The link is valid for {expHours} hours.
string.OtpText:
Confirm your email address to access {app}!

Your confirmation code is below - enter it in the window where you've started signing in for {app}.

{code}

If you didn’t request this email, there’s nothing to worry about — you can safely ignore it.

string.SignUpOtpHTML:
Confirm your email address to access {app}!

Your confirmation code is below - enter it in the window where you've started signing up for {app}.


{code}

The code is only valid for a few minutes. If it expired or you closed the window, finish signing up with this link.

{link}

If you didn’t request this email, there’s nothing to worry about — you can safely ignore it.
string.ResendInviteText: You have been re-invited to {ws}. Please use the following link to join: {link}. The re-invitation link is valid for {expHours} hours.
string.ResendInviteHTML:
You have been re-invited to {ws}. To join, click the link below: Join

If the invite link above does not work, paste the following link into your browser's URL bar: {link}

The re-invitation link is valid for {expHours} hours.
string.AdminOtpSubject: Confirmation code for an administrator action
string.AdminOtpText:
You are about to perform a sensitive administrator action in {app} (deleting/archiving a workspace, changing members or a subscription, renaming a URL, or deleting an account).

Your confirmation code is:

{code}

Enter it in the admin panel to confirm. If you did not initiate this action, do NOT share this code and review your account security.
string.AdminOtpHTML:
You are about to perform a sensitive administrator action in {app} (deleting/archiving a workspace, changing members or a subscription, renaming a URL, or deleting an account).

Your confirmation code is:

{code}

Enter it in the admin panel to confirm. If you did not initiate this action, do NOT share this code and review your account security.
string.WorkspaceDeletionScheduledText: The workspace {ws} ({url}) is scheduled for deletion on {date}. It stays open read-only for a while so the data can be taken out, then it is archived, and on that date it and its backup are gone for good. Any owner can call the deletion off until then: {link}
string.WorkspaceDeletionScheduledHTML:
The workspace {ws} ({url}) is scheduled for deletion on {date}.

It stays open read-only for a while so the data can be taken out, then it is archived, and on that date it and its backup are gone for good.

Any owner can call the deletion off until then: {link}
string.WorkspaceDeletedText: The workspace {ws} ({url}) is being deleted right now, without the usual deferral. The data and its backup cannot be recovered.
string.WorkspaceDeletedHTML:
The workspace {ws} ({url}) is being deleted right now, without the usual deferral.

The data and its backup cannot be recovered.
string.AccountDeletionScheduledSubject: Your account is scheduled for deletion
string.AccountDeletionScheduledText: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {date}. Signing in before that date lets you call it off: {link}
string.AccountDeletionScheduledHTML:
Your account is scheduled for deletion on {date}.

Signing in before that date lets you call it off: {link}
string.AccountDeletedText: Your account has been deleted. Everything identifying you is gone and the address is free for a new sign up.
string.AccountDeletedHTML:
Your account has been deleted.

Everything identifying you is gone and the address is free for a new sign up.
